title: Datacentres to create 70% more carbon emissions by 2030, IEA report warns
summary_full: Global energy watchdog forecasts huge rise as US and China turn to fossil fuels to power AI growth agendas  The world’s datacentres will create 70% more carbon emissions within the next four years as the US and China turn to fossil fuels to power their AI growth agendas, according to the world’s energy watchdog.The International Energy Agency (IEA) warned that datacentres will consume twice as much electricity by 2030 compared with today, with the global expansion of artificial intelligence accounting for three-quarters of this growth.
